title: Ready for the ten pages: a look, a cover sketch, the numbers
headline: Everything around your ten pages is ready except the words. The designer has the look and a cover sketch beside Gen ZX Founders (LAB 18), the researcher has a sheet of the numbers the pages may use, and the publisher's build can make the sample. The storyteller outlines at 17:39 and the publisher writes at 18:47, so the PDF comes tonight. Fire the storyteller now and it comes sooner.

for_you.ask: The cover sketch below: this book as one of a Gen ZX Founders series?
for_you.detail: The sketch shares the Gen ZX Founders cover's system (dark ground, stacked capitals, a prompt line), not its mark. The title on it is the working one, unsigned; the series line stays only if you sign G1.

for_you.ask: Chapter 01: what were you looking at when you said 95%?
for_you.detail: The publisher's voice read: the record cannot say where your 95% came from; only you can. In your voice it becomes one sentence: what you were looking at, or that you no longer know. Yours to write, not the team's to guess.
